items.quote: A few years ago, only the top 5% of real estate agents in Dubai could afford to have a personal assistant—those who were willing to invest big to free up their time and focus on what they do best: selling and making money.
items.statement: A few years ago, only the top 5% of real estate agents in Dubai could afford to have a personal assistant.

items.quote: But now, thanks to technology, every agent not only can have an assistant, but should.
items.statement: Thanks to technology, every agent not only can have an assistant but should.

items.quote: 6 months ago, I was approached by a team of developers with a mission—create an AI-powered personal assistant specifically for real estate agents.
items.statement: I was approached by a team of developers to create an AI-powered personal assistant specifically for real estate agents.

items.quote: We gathered feedback from a focus group of agents across Dubai, France, Spain, the USA, and other countries.
items.statement: Feedback from a focus group of agents across multiple countries was gathered.

items.quote: Knock-Knock, and while it’s only at 10% of its final capabilities, it can already help you: ✅ Write property descriptions ✅ Create content plans...
items.statement: The assistant, called Knock-Knock, can help with writing property descriptions and other tasks.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing AI-powered personal assistant for real estate agents.
